jobs.description:
Do you possess an IRATA Level 3 certificate, are you technically skilled, and do you enjoy working at heights? Do you enjoy leading and supervising operational teams, with a keen eye for safety and quality, and do you also like to roll up your sleeves? Furthermore, do you have an affinity for technical work and various industries, and are you up for working on the most challenging projects in hard-to-reach locations, such as at height and in confined spaces? Then this position as Rope Access Technician/Supervisor at Sky-Access B.V. is exactly what you are looking for! Company is based in Roosendaal.

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone:

• With a valid IRATA level 3 certificate (hard demand)
• Who enjoys being physically active in their work
• Who has an affinity for working safely, the various industries, and technology
• With a flexible and positive work attitude, a team player
• Who has technical insight and enjoys working with their hands
• With a technical background
• With the necessary capabilities and ambition to take responsibility for rope safety on the projects
• Who takes initiative, both solicited and unsolicited, and provides advice on IRATA-related knowledge, skills, and methodologies
• Who is willing to work occasionally at irregular times (weekends/nights)
• With a good command of English
• Who holds a B driving license
• With VCA-VOL certification (or willing to obtain it)

________________________________________

What do we offer you?
• Contract duration: Intention is a permanent contract. First year a fixed term contract of 12 months (will be changed into a permanent contract if skills, performance and work attitude are meeting company demands)
Trial period: 1 month
Salary range (gross/month): €3.500 – €4.000 in accordance with the Collective Labour Agreement for the Small Metal Industry
Housing: Employer offers suitable housing for the first period (to help the foreign colleque) – for this a contribution of the costs are for the account of employee (cost indication: between € 500 and € 600)
• A varied and challenging job within an enthusiastic and close-knit team
• Ample opportunities for personal development (IRATA upgrades, courses, advancement to project manager, IRATA part-time roles)
• Working on unique and technically challenging projects, both nationally and internationally
• Support and guidance in your career and certification processes
• A no-nonsense company culture with a focus on safety and quality

SSAB Services, Hardox Wearparts is a rapidly growing business unit with ambitious targets. As Business & Technical Development Manager for Hardox Wearparts you will be an integral part of building and implementing a new business model. 

You will participate in the development and conceptualization of the new business model, including the future product and service mix as well as the go-to market setup. Placement is optional.

Responsibilities include

•Business concept: Conceptualization and structuring of existing knowledge in order to define the  service offer

•Product and service portfolio evaluation and definition

•Development of trainings and manuals

•Piloting the new concept, preparing for future concept sales

•Mapping end user needs to ensure concept success

You will report to the Head of Hardox Wearparts Concept Management.

Your qualifications
To be successful in this role you need to have a master degree in engineering or equivalent. 

We believe that you have at least 5 years experience of working with wear products and/or maintenance in the one of the aggregates industries. You have strong social skills and experience from successfully driving and implementing development. 

You have a curious mind and strong analytical skills paired with good technical understanding of wear in practice (maintenance and wear products). As a lot of the future development will have a strong connection to digital tools and systems development, you need an overall understanding of the possibilities that exist within digital development. 

You are fluent in English and thrive in an international environment where global contacts are part of the every day work. Speaking Dutch is a plus as the position wil be based in the Netherlands.

As a person you are positive and interested in new ideas - and in making them happen. 

We offer
You will be part of, and have the possibility to grow within, an international and dynamic organization that is developing rapidly. Hardox Wearparts has ambitious growth targets and as a vital member of the development team, you will contribute to our future success. 

Application
Send your application no later than 20th of March 2019

For more information, please contact
Nancy Matos, Manager Hardox Wearparts Concept, phone +46 155 255 422

What does a Critical Infrastructure NOC Manager do at LCL? 
 

As a Critical Infrastructure NOC Manager, you will contribute to building a standardized and scalable NOC operation across all data center sites. You will share responsibility for the daily operational management and ongoing development of the NOC. You will develop, implement, and optimize processes, procedures, runbooks, and incident management practices to ensure the NOC team responds quickly, accurately, and consistently to alarms, incidents, and operational challenges. 
 

In addition, you will establish a strong training and knowledge management framework. Through onboarding programs, training initiatives, and hands-on simulations, you will strengthen the technical expertise and decision-making capabilities of NOC employees. You will coach, motivate, and develop a team of 12 NOC professionals working in a continuous 24/7 operational environment. You will ensure strict adherence to incident management procedures by training operators, monitoring compliance with escalation paths, customer communication standards, and reporting requirements, and driving continuous process improvement. You will oversee the quality of monitoring, alarm handling, incident response, and ticket management processes, ensuring that critical alerts receive prompt and appropriate attention. As a key link between the NOC, field technicians, technical experts, IT teams, and external partners, you will foster efficient collaboration and clear communication across all sites.
 

You will report directly to the Critical Infrastructure Manager. Your primary workplace will be Aalst, with regular coordination and collaboration across LCL’s other locations.

Is this the right opportunity for you?
 
 

• You hold at least a bachelor's degree, preferably in a technical field, or have acquired equivalent knowledge through relevant experience. 

• You have previous experience leading technical teams and know how to coach, motivate, and develop employees, preferably within a 24/7 or continuous operations environment. 

• You have experience with operational processes in a technical or critical infrastructure environment. Experience in a data center or NOC environment is a strong asset. 

• You possess solid technical knowledge of electrical systems and HVAC and are familiar with monitoring tools, BMS and/or DCIM systems. 

• You have a process-oriented mindset, bring structure to complex environments, and develop clear procedures. You document accurately and ensure knowledge remains up to date. 

• You have strong analytical skills, quickly identify patterns and root causes, and translate insights into sustainable improvements. Experience with change management and continuous improvement initiatives is a significant advantage. 

• You communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, promote standardized ways of working, and actively encourage knowledge sharing and coaching. You are comfortable providing guidance and corrective feedback when needed. 

• You have a good command of Dutch, French, and English, both spoken and written.

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - part-time or weekend work
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Officer Polish-Dutch-English, you are the first point of contact for customers from all over Europe. You handle phone calls and emails professionally, quickly switching between Polish, Dutch, and English. You gather information, ensure proper follow-up, and provide technical support in case of breakdowns or logistical questions. Thanks to your efforts, vehicles get back on the road quickly and you help customers when they need it most.

A typical workday is varied: you answer calls, juggle multiple cases, communicate with garages, and keep customers and partners informed of the latest updates. You work in a small, close-knit team where everyone supports each other. During busier periods, you may work on Saturdays. Your shifts are flexible, between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM, Monday through Friday.

Are you ready to use your language skills and problem-solving abilities in a warm, international environment? Apply today and discover new challenges every day, meet unique people, and further develop your talents!

• You are fluent in Polish, Dutch, and English (other languages are a plus)

• You are comfortable working with computers and proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

• You communicate clearly and efficiently by phone and email

• You are customer-focused, stress-resistant, and work accurately

• You are solution-oriented and enjoy variety in your work

• Experience in a similar position or technical knowledge is a plus, but not required
